The '''Credaan system''' was located within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] shared its name with the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] model known as the [[Credaan Spacer]].<ref name="TBA">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Credaan system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square M-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
